findings.title: Missing homogeneity area specification
findings.message: The short and long texts lack a specification of the homogeneity area (e.g., B1, B2) required for the excavation according to DIN 18300. Without this, the extent of the excavation and the associated geotechnical risk are unclear.
findings.suggestion: Add a homogeneity area reference and depth limits, e.g., "Baugrube ausheben, Homogenbereich B1 gemäß Geotechnischem Bericht vom [Datum], Aushubtiefe bis 3,00 m."

findings.title: Missing insulation thickness and thermal conductivity
findings.message: The description "Wärmedämmplatten liefern und vollflächig verlegen" omits the required insulation thickness and thermal conductivity (WLS) as mandated by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18331. This omission hampers verification of energy performance.
findings.suggestion: Specify "Wärmedämmplatten XPS, d = 100 mm, WLS 035, druckbelastbar CS(10/Y) 300, Stöße versetzt."

findings.title: Missing water exposure class for earth‑contacted elements
findings.message: The long text does not state the water exposure class (W1–W4) or the type of waterproofing material, which is required by VOB/C § 4.2.1 and DIN 18533. This omission may lead to disputes over suitability and durability.
findings.suggestion: Add "Abdichtung erdberührter Bauteile mit PMBC, Wassereinwirkungsklasse W1.2‑E, Trockenschichtdicke ≥ 3 mm, einschließlich Hohlkehle."

findings.title: Unclear definition of site preparation scope
findings.message: The short text "Baustelleneinrichtung" and the long text "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" are ambiguous regarding which activities (e.g., site office, safety fencing, temporary utilities) are included. This could lead to scope disputes.
findings.suggestion: Specify the exact components, e.g., "Aufstellung von Baustellenbüro, Sicherheitsabgrenzung, temporäre Strom- und Wasserversorgung, Abfallentsorgung, inklusive Vorhaltung bis Fertigstellung."

findings.title: Missing connection details for PE‑HD pipe
findings.message: The long text states "einschließlich Verbindungsteilen", but does not specify the type, size, or standard of the fittings (e.g., ISO 4427, DIN   18258). This may cause later disputes over compatibility.
findings.suggestion: Add "Verbindungsteile nach DIN 18258, ISO 4427, inklusive Flanschverbindungen, Schweißverbindungen, und Dichtungen."

findings.title: Missing concrete mix details for shaft construction
findings.message: The description "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" lacks concrete class, curing regime, and reinforcement details. This omission may affect structural integrity claims.
findings.suggestion: Specify "Betonfertigteile C25/30, nach DIN 1045, mit Stahlbewehrung Ø 12 mm, 3 × 12 mm, nach DIN   1045, 28‑Tage‑Aushärtung."

findings.title: Insufficient detail for interior plastering
findings.message: The long text "Innenputz als einlagigen Putz fachgerecht herstellen" does not state the plaster type, finish, or curing conditions, which are required for quality assurance.
findings.suggestion: Add "Innenputz aus Zement‑Kalk‑Mörtel, einlagig, 20 mm, mit Glättung, Trocknungszeit 48 h, nach DIN    18331."

findings.title: Missing details for cement screed with edge insulation
findings.message: The long text does not specify the screed thickness, edge insulation material, or curing regime, which are necessary for compliance with DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add "Zementestrich CT‑C25‑F4, 20 mm, Randdämmstreifen XPS, 30 mm, Trocknungszeit 72 h, nach DIN 18331."

findings.title: Missing details for paving slab installation
findings.message: The long text "Betonpflaster liefern, verlegen und verfugen" omits the required paving type, joint width, and curing time, which are specified in DIN   18331.
findings.suggestion: Add "Betonpflaster 20 mm, 3 mm Joints, 5 mm Joints, 48 h Trocknung, nach DIN 18331."

findings.title: Missing compaction details for asphalt base layer
findings.message: The long text does not specify the compaction method, density target, or number of passes, which are required by VOB/C § 4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add "Asphalttragschicht 95 t, 3 Passen, Dichte ≥ 95 % MDD, nach DIN    18331."

findings.title: Missing compaction details for asphalt top layer
findings.message: The long text "Asphaltdeckschicht herstellen und verdichten" lacks specification of compaction passes, density, and quality control measures.
findings.suggestion: Add "Asphaltdeckschicht 55 t, 2 Passen, Dichte ≥ 97 % MDD, nach DIN 18331."
